died.name: Anne of Austria
died.cause: looking at her formerly beautiful hands
died.last_words: Monsieur de Montaigu, consider what I owe to God, the favor He has shown me, and the great indulgence for which I am beholden to Him. Observe how they are swelled; time to depart.

died.name: David Garrick
died.desc: English actor, playwright, theatre manager and producer

died.name: John Howard
died.cause: dying of typhus contracted on a prison visit in Kherson
died.last_words: Suffer no pomp at my funeral, nor monumental inscription where I am laid. Lay me quietly in the earth and put a sun-dial over my grave, and let me be forgotten.

died.name: Louis-Michel le Peletier, marquis de Saint-Fargeau
died.cause: assassinated because he voted in favor of Louis XVI's execution the following day

died.name: George V
died.cause: to a nurse giving him a sedative. The King was euthanized on the orders of his doctor, Bertrand Dawson, 1st Viscount Dawson of Penn

died.name: Catherine Steyer
died.cause: The 33-year-old hatcheck girl was accidentally electrocuted by a homemade booby trap, consisting of powered wires hidden within drapes, that her fiance had installed after her apartment was broken into a few months prior. Falling onto one wire, with another dangling above her arm, she completed the circuit each time the dangling wire touched her; she died slowly from the repeating doses of electricity.

died.name: Karel Soucek
died.cause: prior to fatal barrel drop from ceiling of Houston Astrodome a Czech professional stuntman living in Canada who developed a shock-absorbent barrel. He died following a demonstration involving the barrel being dropped from the roof of the Houston Astrodome. He was fatally injured when his barrel hit the rim of the water tank meant to cushion his fall.
died.last_words: I'm ready. It feels good. It's a go.

born.name: Sebastian of Portugal
born.cause: when being advised to surrender, and to hand over his sword to the victors of the Battle of Alcácer Quibir
born.last_words: Royal freedom will only be lost with life

born.name: Lead Belly
born.desc: American folk and blues singer, musician and songwriter
born.last_words: Doctor, if I put this here guitar down now, I ain't never gonna wake up.

born.name: Valery Chkalov
born.cause: fatally injured in crash of Polikarpov I-180 fighter prototype
born.last_words: Do not blame anyone. It's my fault.

born.name: Fireball Roberts
born.cause: inside his burning car after 24 May 1964 wreck during the World 600 at Charlotte Motor Speedway. Roberts survived for six weeks before dying of his injuries
born.last_words: My God, Ned, help me! I'm on fire!
